title: nwc → ss copyright / legal-policy sync record
description: The POST body nwc_copyright::MoodleToolPolicySync::pushToMoodle() sends to the Moodle consumer (local_nwc_copyright_sync → tool_policy). Single-writer rail (NWP-ADR-0031 D2 writer=nwc_copyright). A `version` bump forces student re-consent on the Moodle side, so this is a consent-affecting surface — a schema change here is boundary-touching.

policy_name.description: The Moodle tool_policy target name (e.g. site_terms, privacy_policy). Hard-coupled to the Moodle side (ss:tool_policy:<name>) — renaming silently drops the doc from sync.

version.description: Monotonic integer from versions.yml. A bump forces re-acceptance of the policy on Moodle. Idempotency key for the sync.
